findings: Runtime sensor-memory overhead fell from 10413 scheduled deliveries to 993 while exact threshold direction, lifetime, replay, physical cause, natural quiescence, and the complete workstation ladder remained supported.
The complete measured step fell from 13183 to 3763 scheduled deliveries and its core body phase measured 6688542 CPU nanoseconds on the verification run.
residual_uncertainty: Host CPU time varies between runs; the deterministic delivery count is the stable primary cost evidence.
This candidate is verified development evidence and does not repromote the previously frozen calibration authority.
